key.name: s3-endpoint-url
key.description: S3 endpoint URL (for MinIO, Ceph, etc.).

key.name: s3-access-key
key.description: AWS access key ID. Uses boto3 credential chain if omitted. Prefer environment variable substitution over plaintext values, e.g. ``s3-access-key $(S3_ACCESS_KEY)``. For production, consider omitting this key entirely and using IAM roles or the standard boto3 credential chain instead.

key.name: s3-secret-key
key.description: AWS secret access key. Uses boto3 credential chain if omitted. Prefer environment variable substitution over plaintext values, e.g. ``s3-secret-key $(S3_SECRET_KEY)``. For production, consider omitting this key entirely and using IAM roles or the standard boto3 credential chain instead.

key.name: s3-use-ssl
key.description: Whether to use SSL for S3 connections.

key.name: s3-addressing-style
key.description: S3 addressing style: path, virtual, or auto.

key.name: s3-sse-customer-key
key.description:
Base64-encoded 256-bit (32-byte) key for SSE-C encryption. When set, all S3 uploads are encrypted and reads require this key. Use env var substitution: ``s3-sse-customer-key $(S3_SSE_KEY)`` Requires SSL (s3-use-ssl must be true).
NOTE: AWS will disable SSE-C by default on new buckets from April 2026. Existing buckets are unaffected. For new buckets, enable SSE-C in the bucket policy or consider SSE-KMS instead.

key.name: s3-connect-timeout
key.description: Connect timeout in seconds for uploads, deletes and listings.

key.name: s3-read-timeout
key.description: Socket read timeout in seconds for uploads, deletes and listings. Kept long because some providers answer PUT requests under concurrent load only after more than a minute.

key.name: s3-download-connect-timeout
key.description: Connect timeout in seconds for blob downloads and HEAD requests.

key.name: s3-download-read-timeout
key.description: Socket read timeout in seconds for blob downloads and HEAD requests. This is an inactivity timeout per socket operation, not a limit on the total download time. Downloads block the web request that needs the blob, so a stalled connection must be abandoned quickly.

key.name: s3-download-max-attempts
key.description: Total attempts (first try plus retries) per download and HEAD request, using botocore's standard retry mode.
